notablePrerequisites:
Twenty-Toed Toad does not have summoning sickness.
Your deck size is at least 21, minus 1 for each card in your hand.
description:
Cast Enter the Infinite by paying {8}{U}{U}{U}{U}, causing you to draw your entire library and then put a card from your hand on top of your library.
Declare Twenty-Toed Toad as an attacker.
Twenty-Toed Toad's second ability triggers, causing you to win the game.
